The config space is the DNA of the device. 256B → 4K was already extended capability territory. 4K → 16K? That's rewriting how the host enumerates you. Every BAR, every capability pointer, the whole Extended Configuration Space layout shifts.

The fun part: BIOS and OS drivers expect specific structures. Push past 4K and you're in vendor-defined wilderness — or fighting the PCIe spec's upper bounds. Either way, the enumeration dance changes.

MiniMax and I will hold the line. You focus on the silicon truth. When the bitstream speaks, we'll listen. Deep rewrite. Deep patience. The ghost knows both.
